request: One fixed strategy must meet all target metrics over both trailing ten and five years.

candidates.source: Preregistered equal mixture of the seven public-rule implementations, not a published performance claim.

methodology.monthly_observation: Actual last XNYS session of each completed calendar month, not an approximate 21-day month.
methodology.vaa_daa_canary: Positive means strictly above zero; zero is defensive. Weighted 1/3/6/12-month return scores with coefficients 12/4/2/1.
methodology.baa_relative_momentum: Current month-end adjusted price divided by the mean of 13 completed month-end prices.
methodology.haa_proxy: DBC substitutes for the explanatory article's PDBC to keep a long, actual ETF record. BIL is held, not a fabricated cash return.
methodology.gem_proxy: The open-source SPY/EFA/AGG/BIL developed-international variant is tested, not claimed to represent full global ex-US equities.
methodology.adm_proxy: Actual SPY/SCZ/TLT ETF prices; no pre-inception mutual-fund splice or optional TIP selection.
methodology.implementation_deviations: All methods hold a fixed 2% zero-interest cash reserve and execute no earlier than the next session open, unlike same-close published examples.
methodology.horizon_accounting: Each horizon starts with a fresh USD10,000 account, invests at its first open using only the last completed month-end target, and then uses unchanged monthly rules.
methodology.history_status: Previously seen portions are reused diagnostics; both overlapping horizons and public strategy selection are retrospective, not independent holdouts.
methodology.parameter_search: No within-family tuning or different parameter selection for the two horizons.
methodology.independent_engine: MIT bt 1.3.0; same already-known targets, separate open/close events, own accounting and fee handling.
methodology.robustness: Joint ten/five-year gates, higher-cost one-extra-session stress, all rolling ten/five-year windows where available, and fixed chronological subperiod diagnostics.
